reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
), numbered AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    SUM(new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
  FROM flagged
), sessions AS (
  -- one row per session
  SELECT account_id, user_id, session_no, epoch(MAX(event_ts)) - epoch(MIN(event_ts)) AS length_seconds
  FROM numbered
  GROUP BY account_id, user_id, session_no
)
SELECT account_id, ROUND(AVG(length_seconds) / 60, 2) AS avg_session_minutes
FROM sessions
GROUP BY account_id

WITH flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_ts, event_id,
    CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) IS NULL
      OR epoch(event_ts) - epoch(LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id)) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM app_events
), numbered AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    SUM(new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
  FROM flagged
), sessions AS (
  -- one row per session
  SELECT account_id, user_id, session_no, date_diff('second', MIN(event_ts), MAX(event_ts)) AS length_seconds
  FROM numbered
  GROUP BY account_id, user_id, session_no
)
SELECT account_id, ROUND(SUM(length_seconds) / 60.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_session_minutes
FROM sessions
GROUP BY account_id

WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts,
    LEAD(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS next_ts
  FROM app_events
), starts AS (
  -- one row per session start
  SELECT user_id, account_id, event_ts AS session_start
  FROM gaps
  WHERE prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes'
), ends AS (
  -- one row per session end
  SELECT user_id, event_ts AS session_end
  FROM gaps
  WHERE next_ts IS NULL OR next_ts - event_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes'
), paired AS (
  -- one row per session
  SELECT s.account_id, s.user_id, s.session_start,
    (SELECT MIN(e.session_end) FROM ends e WHERE e.user_id = s.user_id AND e.session_end >= s.session_start) AS session_end
  FROM starts s
)
SELECT account_id, ROUND(AVG(epoch(session_end) - epoch(session_start)) / 60, 2) AS avg_session_minutes
FROM paired
GROUP BY account_id

other_way.tradeoff: Pairing each session start with the first session end after it skips the numbering, but every start searches the ends again.

solver.query:
WITH f AS (SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts, event_name, CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER w IS NULL OR event_ts - LAG(event_ts) OVER w > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ns FROM app_events WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id)),
s AS (SELECT *, SUM(ns) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS sn FROM f),
ss AS (SELECT user_id, account_id, sn, MIN(event_ts) AS st, MAX(event_ts) AS en, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY user_id, account_id, sn) SELECT account_id, ROUND(AVG(epoch(en - st) / 60.0), 2) AS avg_session_minutes FROM ss GROUP BY account_id
